title.narrative: Provision of integrated life-saving WASH service to the drought affected communities in under-served and hard-to-reach rural areas in Afgoye district

description.narrative: ltpgtSevere drought conditions are unfolding in several regions of Somalia following the failure of the Deyr (October to December) rains, compounding an already serious humanitarian crisis. On 18 November, South West State authorities warned that dry conditions have caused severe water scarcity, widespread crop failure, and increased livestock diseases in Bay, Bakool, and Lower Shabelle regions. Pastoral and agro-pastoral households have exhausted their coping mechanisms, and displaced populations are at heightened risk of further hardship. New Ways is proposing a 10-month integrated WASH project targeting the community likely to be affected by the crisis reaching a total of 15,000 persons including (4,300 men, 6,300 women, 2,300 girls, and 2,100 boys). In this project, New Ways aims to improve access to life-saving WASH services for people living in Afgoye district of Lower Shabelle region of South West State with recognition of people with disabilities, and the most vulnerable population. New Ways Organization will undertake the following activities in this project:ltbrgtConstruction of 50 normal latrines and 12 latrines for people living with disabilities to benefit residents in Afgoye town and the rural areasltbrgtHygiene promotions sessions will be conducted regularly and cleaning-up campaigns using the provided sanitation tools.ltbrgtProvision of safe drinking water to 2500 individuals through rehabilitation of shallow wells and construction of water tanks with water kiosksltbrgtDistribution of hygiene kits to 1500 Households.lt/pgtltpgtProvision of water through water trucking to 680 Households for 45 daysltbrgt10 Hygiene promoters will be recruited and trainedltbrgtRehabilitation of 3 shallow wells and construction of 1 in the target locationsltbrgtMonitoring and Supervision exercise twice during the project periodltbrgt4 WASH committees will be established and trained to improve all preventive measures against the risks of AWD/cholera outbreaksltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtChlorination of the wells through recruited hygiene promoters i.e 10 shallow wells for the project period. ltbrgt80 packs of sanitation tools will be procured and distributed in the target locationsltbrgtProvision of spare parts and water system accessoriesltbrgtConduct 1 post distribution monitoring exercise at the tail end of the projectlt/pgt
